description: Synthetic customer-support procedure corpus for a fictional ferry operator. Entirely invented: no real company, route, tariff, customer or employer procedure appears here.

procedures.title: Booking a crossing online
procedures.body: Passengers can book a crossing online up to ninety minutes before departure. Select the route, date, and number of passengers, then choose a vehicle category if travelling with a car. Payment is taken at the time of booking and a booking reference is issued immediately by email. Online booking is available for all routes except the winter-only Sound crossing, which must be booked by telephone.

procedures.title: Amending an existing booking
procedures.body: A booking can be amended once without charge up to twenty-four hours before departure. Amendments within twenty-four hours of departure carry an administration fee equal to fifteen per cent of the fare. Changing the travel date to a higher-priced sailing requires payment of the difference. Amendments are made through the booking reference on the website or through the contact centre.

procedures.title: Refund policy for cancelled bookings
procedures.body: Passengers who cancel a booking more than fourteen days before departure receive a full refund. Cancellations between fourteen days and forty-eight hours before departure receive a refund of seventy-five per cent of the fare. Cancellations within forty-eight hours of departure are not refundable. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within ten working days.

procedures.title: Refund policy for cancelled bookings (current)
procedures.body: Passengers who cancel a booking more than forty-eight hours before departure receive a full refund. Cancellations within forty-eight hours of departure are not refundable unless the cancellation is for a medical reason supported by documentation, in which case a refund of fifty per cent is offered. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within five working days. This policy replaced the earlier fourteen-day tier on 1 March 2026.

procedures.title: Standard baggage allowance
procedures.body: Each passenger may bring two items of hold baggage free of charge. A single item must not exceed twenty-three kilograms. Hand luggage is limited to one bag per passenger, which must fit beneath the seat. Excess baggage is charged at the port at four currency units per kilogram. Bicycles and surfboards are carried as hold baggage and count towards the two-item allowance.

procedures.title: Baggage allowance during the summer promotion
procedures.body: During the summer promotion, each passenger may bring three items of hold baggage free of charge. A single item must not exceed twenty-three kilograms. The additional item is offered automatically on eligible sailings and does not need to be requested. Hand luggage remains limited to one bag per passenger. Excess baggage above the promotional allowance is charged at four currency units per kilogram.

procedures.title: Travelling with pets
procedures.body: Dogs and cats may travel in a vehicle on the car deck at no additional charge. Pets travelling without a vehicle must be carried in an approved carrier and remain in the designated pet area for the duration of the crossing. Assistance dogs may accompany their owner anywhere on the vessel. Pets are not permitted in the passenger lounges or the catering area.

procedures.title: Accessibility and boarding assistance
procedures.body: Passengers requiring boarding assistance should notify the operator at least forty-eight hours before departure. Assistance is provided free of charge and includes help with boarding, moving between decks, and disembarking. Accessible cabins and accessible toilets are available on all vessels in the fleet. A companion travelling with an assisted passenger is entitled to a reduced fare.

procedures.title: Compensation for delayed or cancelled sailings
procedures.body: If a sailing is delayed by more than ninety minutes for reasons within the operator's control, passengers are entitled to a voucher worth thirty per cent of the fare. If a sailing is cancelled, passengers may choose between a full refund and travel on the next available sailing. Compensation is not payable when the delay is caused by weather, tidal conditions, or a direction from a port authority.

procedures.title: Reporting and recovering lost property
procedures.body: Items left on board are held at the arrival port for fourteen days and then transferred to the central lost property office. Passengers should report a lost item within seven days using the online form, quoting the booking reference and the sailing time. Recovered items can be collected in person or returned by courier at the passenger's expense. Perishable items are disposed of after twenty-four hours.

procedures.title: Group bookings of ten or more passengers
procedures.body: Bookings of ten or more passengers are handled by the group travel desk and cannot be completed online. A group booking requires a deposit of twenty per cent at the time of reservation, with the balance due fourteen days before departure. One amendment to passenger numbers is permitted without charge up to seven days before departure. Group bookings are not eligible for the standard online discount.

procedures.title: Onboard catering and dietary requirements
procedures.body: The onboard cafe serves hot and cold food on crossings longer than forty-five minutes. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available on every sailing. Passengers with severe allergies should notify the operator in advance so the galley can be informed. Outside food may be consumed in the passenger lounges but not in the cafe seating area.

procedures.title: Harbourline Rewards programme
procedures.body: The Harbourline Rewards programme awarded one point for every crossing taken. Points could be redeemed against future bookings at a rate of one hundred points to one currency unit. Membership was free and was activated automatically after a passenger's third crossing. The programme closed on 31 January 2026 and no replacement scheme has been announced. Outstanding points cannot be redeemed.

procedures.title: Vehicle categories accepted on board
procedures.body: The operator carries cars, motorcycles, campervans, and light commercial vehicles up to six metres in length. Vehicles longer than six metres, vehicles carrying hazardous goods, and vehicles with more than nine seats must be booked as freight through the freight desk. Vehicle height is restricted to two point four metres on the older vessels. Motorcycles are charged at half the car tariff.

procedures.title: Proposed off-peak discount scheme (draft)
procedures.body: A draft proposal to introduce a fifteen per cent discount on sailings departing before eight in the morning and after nine in the evening. This scheme has not been approved and is not in force. It is included in the corpus to test that draft material is never used to answer a customer question.
